title: Middle East: military escalation reported
body:
8 independent news outlets in the last hour report new strikes or fighting in the Middle East; escalation in the region lifts oil and gold and weighs on risk assets.
Lead report: Israel’s military says it killed 2 men who had launched an attack in the occupied West Bank (union-bulletin.com)

title: Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb: attack reported
body: 8 independent news outlets in the last hour report an attack or strike around the Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb, the route between the Gulf and Europe via Suez.

body: 5 independent news outlets in the last hour report an attack or strike around the Strait of Hormuz, the main export route for Gulf crude and LNG.
